name: Mirai Industry Co.,Ltd.
summary: Mirai Industry Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical equipment materials, water supply and drainage equipment materials, and gas equipment materials in Japan. The company provides flexible synthetic resin conduit, rigid polyvinyl chloride conduits, cable wiring switch boxes, and underground conduits. It also manufactures and sells wiring devices, including switches and outlets; manufactures and sells labor-saving machines, resin molding molds, and vending machines; and manufactures and sells synthetic resin materials.
